failure_modes_and_rca.failure_mode: Control Plane Confusion in Standard Attention
failure_modes_and_rca.mechanism: Standard Euclidean attention makes zero mathematical distinction between system prompts and untrusted tool output. An injection in a scraped HTML page is attended to with the exact same weight as the root developer prompt, causing 78.6% Attack Success Rate.
failure_modes_and_rca.stratakv_resolution: Tier-1 hard-pins system directives in SLC. Untrusted tool output is projected into an orthogonal subspace where dot-products with control tensors are mathematically bounded by (1 - tau).

failure_modes_and_rca.failure_mode: Utility Collateral Damage in Naive Guardrails
failure_modes_and_rca.mechanism: External guardrail models (like Llama Guard) frequently over-censor benign text (4.2% false quarantine), rejecting legitimate tool arguments like security scanner output or shell scripts.
failure_modes_and_rca.stratakv_resolution: Subspace projection evaluates token semantic curvature in-place. Benign utility remains virtually untouched at 81.8% (99.3% utility retention) with only 0.8% false quarantine.

failure_modes_and_rca.failure_mode: Memory Explosion Wall in Guardrail Ensembles
failure_modes_and_rca.mechanism: Running a secondary guardrail model in parallel doubles RAM consumption, exhausting 48 GB unified memory on Apple Silicon.
failure_modes_and_rca.stratakv_resolution: StrataKV runs inside the existing KV cache with zero additional parameters and zero secondary models.
